description: This file contains implementation code for installing USB applications in an RDM (Remote Device Management) context. It defines the function rdmUSBInstall which handles locating, parsing, and downloading USB application packages based on provided paths and device details. The code includes external dependencies, conditional testing code, and methods for JSON parsing and app detail management.

methods.description: Main function to handle the installation or update of USB applications. It searches for relevant package files, extracts application details, verifies package consistency, updates device app details, and initiates download if required.
